complexity.notes: Recursion uses O(log n) stack space where an iterative loop would be O(1); the half-open interval handling with explicit end-start==1 and end-start==0 base cases is correct but more verbose than needed. Using a module-level helper instead of a private method is a minor style choice.
complexity.summary: Standard recursive binary search over the half-open interval [start, end): compare against the midpoint, recurse into the appropriate half, with explicit base cases for empty and single-element ranges.
